study: Source-only calibrated last-linear gradient-variance intervention and conditional-permutation control; known-method research, not novelty
sampling: Four training domains per batch16 each; per-domain deterministic shuffled cycles to ceil(max domain size/16) batches per epoch. Same IDs/order all3 arms; shorter domains oversampled. Full original retained class set, not common-class filtering.
validation: next cyclic source user; four train, one validation, one diagnostic only after selecting weights
permutation_control: shuffle domain IDs within each batch class using local NumPy SeedSequence(seed,held,global_step,917); preserve every class-domain count; independent from torch dropout RNG
moments: last-linear softmax CE per-example gradients; population variance per domain; both real and class-permuted domain moments maintained in all3 arms; conventional bias-corrected EMA raw/(1-beta^step), old state detached; differs author fixed1/(1-beta) normalization
calibration: All arms pure CE through epoch1; at first epoch2 source batch compute full-parameter gradient L2 norms of CE and REAL EMA penalty. Fixed lambda=clip(.1*CE_norm/real_penalty_norm,1e-4,1e4). Same warmup/model/EMA/dropout/sampler makes exact same lambda all3 arms. Never recalibrated; store norms/clip flag and EMA. Uses no validation or diagnostic examples. This is one-batch heuristic, not an optimal coefficient.
objective: balanced_erm CE only; real_variance CE+fixed lambda*real EMA variance discrepancy; permuted_variance CE+same lambda*conditional-permutation EMA discrepancy. No optimizer reset, no extra augmentation. Single dropout forward used by CE and penalty.
primary_selection: fixed dense parameter average over actual optimizer updates epochs13-24
secondary_selection: earliest minimum validation CE including epoch0; never substitute for primary
reused_control: ordinary24 shared128 tail from SWAD source, supplementary strong baseline; differs sampler and slightly per-epoch sample count
stop_on_failed_gate: No lambda/EMA/warmup/seed/tail/normalizer/coordinate grid or eight-fold expansion of this frozen hypothesis
pass_next_step: Further same-protocol eight-user controls and independent seeds; does not establish original contribution
persistence: everyepoch segment, full source orders/IDs, model/AdamW/scheduler/CPU RNG/best/tail and BOTH EMA states/count/scale/calibration. Atomic epoch checkpoints; queue lock; functional inference audit; warmup and lambda cross-arm equality audited.
limitations: six repeatedly researched development users; overlapping training sets; one seed
source mechanism was eval-mode common-class subset; training-mode dropout and full labels differ
conditional-shuffle control preserves class-domain imbalance rather than removing all domain information
end-to-end all-parameter gradients for scale but regularizer statistics only last linear layer
standard corrected EMA and source norm calibration differ author Fishr; not exact reproduction
known-module composition not original contribution; main paper full text not read
